reviews.requirement: Review AP63203 buck, DC-biased capacitance, USB current/descriptor/J4 sequencing, narrow branch traces, back-powering and thermal test plan.
Approve PE42442 mapping, matching topology and RF/clock layout for prototype tuning; explicitly review the crystal pin-10 distance screening failure.
Confirm fabricator stackup, RF impedance, USB differential geometry and uninterrupted return paths.
Approve exact parts, tolerances, ratings, sourcing and assembly substitutions.

Check connector drawings, SMA vertical fit, antenna keepout, solder/paste and orientation. Require resin-filled/copper-capped vias at C21 (46.5,18.9) and U5 EP (16,19.4), plus DFM review of all pad-adjacent vias.
Obtain independent human electrical/RF review of the exact candidate and documented prototype risks.
